name: AbuseIPDB
tagline: Crowdsourced IP abuse reputation and blacklist checks for security tooling
description: AbuseIPDB provides a REST API for checking IP addresses against a community-reported abuse database, reporting abusive IPs, and retrieving blacklist data. Developers use it to score inbound traffic, enrich security logs, and feed WAF or firewall rules with reputation signals.

auth.details: API key via Key header (also Accept: application/json). Obtain key from account dashboard after free signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1,000 check requests/day on free Standard plan; higher on paid tiers (see pricing)

rate_limits: Daily check quotas by plan (free: 1,000/day); additional rate limiting may apply — see pricing and API docs
use_cases: check abuse reputation score for a client IP
report an abusive IP with category and comment
download a blacklist of high-confidence abusive IPs
enrich security logs with ISP and country for an IP
gate login or API access by abuse confidence score
